name: slidev-extensions
description: Installable root for the slidev-extensions tools: npm i -g github:stn1slv/slidev-extensions
_comment: postinstall rather than prepare: a prepare script makes npm run a nested install inside the git clone, and under `npm i -g` that nested install inherits global mode and installs a symlink to the temporary clone. postinstall runs once the package sits in its final place and needs only Node.
